# CareInflow

> CareInflow is a healthcare-focused web design and digital growth studio in Mehsana, Gujarat, India. It builds websites, does local SEO, and manages Google Business Profiles for doctors and clinics — healthcare practices only. Founded by Jaidev Jethi. Contact: WhatsApp +91 97734 56668, jaydevjethi123@gmail.com.

CareInflow is a new studio (2026) currently choosing five founding practices. It publishes fixed prices in writing after a free written review, makes no ranking guarantees, and does not buy reviews or resell templates. It works from a single studio in Mehsana with no branch offices, serving practices across Mehsana, Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, Visnagar, Unjha, Patan, Kalol, Siddhpur, Palanpur, and the wider North Gujarat region.

## Services

- [Healthcare websites](https://careinflow.com/services/healthcare-websites/): Custom clinic websites — a page per treatment, WhatsApp enquiry flow, speed measured on mid-range Android phones (reference <1.2s LCP), WCAG AA accessibility.
- [Local SEO](https://careinflow.com/services/local-seo/): Treatment and location pages, technical SEO, schema markup, Search Console setup, AI answer readiness. No ranking promises.
- [Google Business Profile management](https://careinflow.com/services/google-business-profile/): Profile setup, categories, services, photos, hours, and honest review strategy — maintained monthly.
- [Ongoing website care](https://careinflow.com/services/website-care/): Weekly monitoring, monthly maintenance and backups, quarterly written reviews. Month to month; clients own all accounts.
- [Social media for clinics](https://careinflow.com/services/social-media/): A support service, not a core one — educational posts, treatment explainers and clinic updates written within patient-privacy limits. No paid advertising, no follower-count chasing, and CareInflow will say so when a practice's website or Google listing needs fixing first.

## Key pages

- [Free written review](https://careinflow.com/free-review/): The starting point. Send the clinic's name on WhatsApp; within two working days CareInflow returns a free written review covering listing accuracy, mobile load time, treatment page coverage, review handling, AI answer readiness, and the three clinics ranking above you. No obligation.
- [Method](https://careinflow.com/process/): The four-week build: study, structure & words, design & build, launch then stay.
- [Pricing philosophy](https://careinflow.com/pricing/): Fixed price in writing after a free review; no hourly billing, no discounts.
- [Work](https://careinflow.com/work/): Real projects only — including a bilingual dental clinic website in Mehsana (pramukhdentalclinic.com).
- [Resources](https://careinflow.com/resources/): Plain-language guides for clinic owners on patient behaviour, Google Business Profile, local SEO, and website speed.
- [FAQ](https://careinflow.com/faq/): Costs, timelines, ownership (clients own everything), and what CareInflow will not do.
- [Contact](https://careinflow.com/contact/): One WhatsApp message gets a free written review within two working days.
